description: Test suite for starboard audio sink functionality, including tests for update status, frame consumption, pause, underflow, and continuous appending.

classes.name: AudioSinkTestFrameBuffers
classes.description: Handles buffer management for audio sink tests.

classes.name: AudioSinkTestEnvironment
classes.description: Provides environment setup and control for audio sink tests.

methods.name: WaitUntilUpdateStatusCalled
methods.description: Waits until the update status callback is invoked.

methods.name: WaitUntilSomeFramesAreConsumed
methods.description: Waits until some audio frames are consumed.

methods.name: WaitUntilAllFramesAreConsumed
methods.description: Waits until all audio frames are consumed.

methods.name: AppendFrame
